0022600161.text: The Knicks (2-3) enter this home game on a two-game winning streak, sitting 8th in the East and 2 games back in the Atlantic, while the winless Brooklyn Nets (0-4) have lost four straight and sit 15th in the East. Jose Alvarado is out for New York with an ankle sprain, and Egor Demin is out for Brooklyn with a leg bruise. New York won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, and its most recent meeting, in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026, ended in a 93-92 Knicks win, while the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
